_readme: Your identity and contact details. Same rule as stats.json: anything left as 'placeholder' keeps the warning banner up. Fill these in, then set source to 'verified'.

bio.value: I built RU SnipeZ in December 2023 after missing a section I needed by about ninety seconds. It has run every registration period since. Everything on this page comes from operating it: the polling design, the data layer that gives Rutgers index numbers meaning, and the parts that broke along the way.

resume.note: Optional. Drop a PDF in public/ and point here, e.g. /resume.pdf. Leave empty to hide the button.

api.note: Link to the course-data API repo or docs. Leave empty and the API section hides itself.
